listing.name: NHL 2K8 — NHL2K8-Recompiled (anishchandra24)
listing.summary: The project reports boot, menus, quick games, franchise, tournaments and save/load tests on two PCs. Crowd stutter, pale-red colouring and brightness defects remain. Online play is unsupported, and dependency installation on a clean machine has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own extracted title 54540809 version 0.0.0.3 folder with all game files. Its default.xex must be 9383936 bytes with SHA256 BA4E63334FAF296019657C6E86BBD444CB05646E29FA6C7B72F4BF9709CE4225.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the v0.2.0 setup to build locally with its pinned patched SDK. Install the documented VS2022 Community Clang and CMake prerequisites. The player targets Windows x64 with D3D12.

warnings: The project reports boot, menus, quick games, franchise, tournaments and save/load tests on two PCs. Crowd stutter, pale-red colouring and brightness defects remain. Online play is unsupported, and dependency installation on a clean machine has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
